# Isaiah Chapter 66 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 24 verses]*

*Heaven is throne, earth footstool; humble and contrite; Zion's sudden birth; new moon to new moon; all flesh worships*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you. This chapter heaven is throne, earth footstool.

*-- LOGOS*
